title: ECB Data Portal exchange rates and statistical reference series
license_or_terms: ESCB free public-statistics reuse with attribution, unchanged source statistics; third-party exclusions
cadence: Daily/monthly depending on series; revisions possible
limitations: Preserve original observations; derived currency conversions separately labelled and rights-reviewed. Reference FX is not project financing/forward price; FX conversion alone is not local cost calibration.
integration_mode: Pinned economic series + explicit derived money-basis transformation

title: Eurostat HICP/PPI and non-household energy-price benchmarks
license_or_terms: Commercial/noncommercial reuse with attribution; individual notices and third-party/geography exceptions; consolidated review requires exact table/geography/source notice and resolves overlapping EU-C19 conservatively, not by choosing the more permissive entry
cadence: Monthly indices; energy-price periods depend on table
limitations: Use exact geo/table/consumption band/tax basis. National statistical averages are not site tariffs. No blanket rights assertion for all non-European or third-party data.
integration_mode: Economic series and benchmark items; no fabricated tariff schedule

title: BLS public CPI/PPI/labor statistics
access: API v1 public limited; v2 registration/limits
license_or_terms: API terms and government-data notices; attribution/retrieval date; no implied endorsement
limitations: Select the appropriate cost index; general CPI is not automatically equipment-specific. A typed read-only POST connector needs separate admission from existing GET-only web fetch.
integration_mode: Versioned economic series; bounded documented connector

title: Statistics Canada Web Data Service
license_or_terms: Statistics Canada Open Licence; source/adaptation notice, no endorsement and third-party exceptions
limitations: Select province/product/calendar/basis. Public statistics do not supply a private site meter, tariff, debt quote or actual maintenance history.
integration_mode: Canada-specific reference series with original table/PID and release

title: Bank of Canada Valet
license_or_terms: Bank terms require attribution; data/third-party and permitted-use conditions need scoped review
limitations: Indicative rates not transaction quotes, WACC or loan offers; do not imply Bank endorsement or mirror third-party series without rights.
integration_mode: Pinned CAD reference data; no implicit finance assumptions

title: INEGI indicators and downloadable statistics
access: API token for indicator service; public downloads available
license_or_terms: INEGI free-use terms, attribution and transformed-data notices; exact selected item terms to retain
limitations: Do not apply a US inflation series by default to Mexican costs. API tokens remain server-owned credentials.
integration_mode: Mexico-specific economic series and explicitly chosen cost escalation

title: Banco de Mexico SIE time-series API
access: Token-managed public API; catalog visible without data request
license_or_terms: Public API documentation verified; redistribution terms not established in this research
limitations: Official catalog includes SF43718 MXN/USD FIX. Do not treat policy/TIIE rate as project debt or assert sublicense rights from API availability.
integration_mode: Metadata-first connector candidate; scoped rights review before distribution

title: Copernicus ERA5 single-level hourly reanalysis
access: CDS account, dataset terms acceptance and API; no bulk download performed
license_or_terms: Dataset page labels CC-BY licence; retain exact applicable licence/version and attribution
cadence: Hourly values; daily provisional updates then final revisions
limitations: Reanalysis is not a site sensor or future weather forecast; ERA5T can change. Preserve weather-year identity, gridding, provisional/final state and source correlation. Reuse native atlite pipeline.
integration_mode: Source/version-pinned weather references; derived regional profiles through existing tooling

title: JRC PVGIS non-interactive API
geography: Europe; verify selected radiation database footprint for NA
license_or_terms: API docs verified; underlying radiation database and site reuse terms require dataset-specific review
limitations: Modelled PV is not measured plant output. Pin API and radiation database version and system losses; do not use TMY as a multi-year reliability ensemble.
integration_mode: Optional profile oracle/source; do not duplicate native renewable-profile engine by default

title: NLR NSRDB solar resource APIs
access: Developer key and usage limits; dataset endpoints differ
license_or_terms: Public API docs; selected source/model rights and attribution must be checked separately
cadence: Annual/versioned model releases; selected temporal resolution
limitations: Do not infer every endpoint covers all Canada/Mexico. Preserve local/UTC, interval and leap-day options; API credentials never in model-visible prompts/exports.
integration_mode: Optional bounded source connector and native profile generation

title: ComStock public end-use profiles
access: Public release downloads; no bulk retrieval performed
license_or_terms: Public release index verified; exact OEDI item licence not retrieved due429; software licence is not data permission
cadence: Versioned releases with weather and model year
limitations: Synthetic calibrated building-stock outputs, not measured individual factories/DC/mines. Release notices report e.g missing California water heating and weather issues in particular releases; preserve exclusions.
integration_mode: Curated synthetic archetypes with release/weather/upgrade and known-issue metadata

title: OPSD contributed household/small-business measurements
access: Public versioned downloads; metadata only inspected
license_or_terms: Dataset page declares Creative Commons Attribution-International; resolve exact version in pinned datapackage before packaging
limitations: Small historical sample, not a regional industrial default. Values may be interval energy/cumulative-derived rather than MW; preserve interpolation/missing-data flags. Do not reidentify premises.
integration_mode: Small reference/QA fixture or explicitly scoped shape; never generic mine/DC profile

title: US EPA eGRID electricity emissions factors
license_or_terms: EPA official FAQ states eGRID data public domain and commercial/noncommercial use allowed
cadence: Edition based on a specified data year
limitations: Annual geographic average is not hourly marginal emissions or verified location/time-matched green-fuel eligibility. Denominator/gases/region/year must match.
integration_mode: Versioned emissions-factor benchmark with explicit accounting boundary

title: EEA electricity generation GHG intensity
license_or_terms: EEA CC-BY material policy, dataset notices and third-party exclusions
limitations: Country gross-generation average not site marginal intensity; distinguish production vs consumption mix and preserve underlying inventory/Eurostat provenance.
integration_mode: Versioned emissions reference; separate from carbon market price
